# Shuttle Brief
The Gantry is a medium engineering shuttle designed around reliable fabrication, repair, material recovery, and field support.
Its larger workspace and broader equipment set make it better suited than the Rivet for sustained engineering operations.
[italic]Brought to you by Stonian Industries.[/italic]

# Operational Notes
Standard recommendations:
1. Take note of standard Piloting guides.
2. Take note of relevant standard role guides.
3. Ensure all critical components are anchored.
4. Take note of base power load and adjust generators accordingly to reduce fuel consumption.
5. Follow proper cleaning and maintenance guidelines.
6. Ship modification is encouraged; we will buy your ship back regardless of condition.
7. Have a safe and productive shift whenever possible.
